dct_description_sm: Dataset of water temperature readings at ten stations in Bilston Creek Watershed, continuously measured at 15-minute intervals using ONSET Hobo MX2201 sensors. Water temperature dataset is part of a broader water quality monitoring program aimed at identifying water quality status and trends within Coastal Cutthroat Trout habitat. The ten monitoring stations, located in Bilston, Hewitt and Pritchard Creeks and Martin Brook, are a representative subset of freshwater ecology across the Bilston Watershed that encompasses 3129 ha in Sc’ianew territory, Langford and Metchosin, Capital Regional District, BC.
dct_title_s: Bilston Watershed Habitat Protection Association Water Temperature Loggers
